verdict.rationale: Puzzle advertises an API (puzzle.io/api) and an MCP setup guide, suggesting some programmatic/agentic access, but there is no evidence of actual official SDKs (no language-specific libraries, GitHub repos, or SDK docs), and probes for OpenAPI/spec files returned 404s. missing for 10: dedicated SDK documentation or repos, code samples in multiple languages, confirmation of OpenAPI spec availability.
